name: Tsuji Kaito
source:
One of the members of 3 Majesty.

Kaito is the youngest member of the group. He was specifically chosen after attending the Prince Rep. audition.

Underneath his cool exterior, he is actually quite bashful and has a hard time expressing himself to others.

[from [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Tokimeki_Restaurant%E2%98%86%E2%98%86%E2%98%86]Koei Wikia[/url]]
